decision: 008 is usability-only and strictly bounded: armed-terminal chrome (no PTY/exec change), legacy theming via a token BRIDGE (not per-page redesign), and the 5-state surface matrix generalized from cockpit-state. No architecture-model changes, no new action-execution channel.
rationale: Operator directive (2026-06-07): finish the operator-console usability layer now that Plan A settled the confidence/freshness truth contract, without expanding the architecture intelligence.

decision: Legacy theming is a bridge that redefines the legacy core.css colour vars in terms of --dp-* tokens under [data-theme]/[data-density], rather than rewriting each page's CSS.
rationale: Lightest correct migration: theme/density swaps cascade onto every legacy page through existing var consumption; avoids a 10-page redesign and keeps the diff reviewable.

decision: F003 generalizes the existing cockpit-state.js classifier (states loading/error/missing/stale/ready) into a surface-agnostic module reused by every key surface; thresholds stay aligned to freshness.js AGING_MAX so classifier and rendered banner never disagree.
rationale: One source of state truth, many renderers — same render-truth posture the cockpit already proved.

decision: F003 delivers the surface-state matrix as a REUSABLE module (classifySurfaceState + renderSurfaceChrome) proven across all five states for every key-surface label, with the cockpit as the live wired consumer (from 005). Per-page wiring of the other legacy surfaces is incremental adoption, not part of 008 — wiring each page's render would be the per-page redesign 008 explicitly excludes. The matrix is available + shell-proven; pages adopt it as they next change.
rationale: Honest scope: deliver the single source + prove it through the real shell without a 10-page redesign the non-goals forbid.

decision: Closed completed: shipped + merged to main as PR #26 (operator-console 008 armed chrome + legacy theme bridge + 5-state matrix); audited under the 2026-06-08 retroactive Codex audit + remediation. Status flipped from active to completed in the 2026-06-08 close-out pass.
rationale: Ledger reconciliation — all features passed + merged + audited; status had lagged reality.
